Jehoiada appointed the officers of Yahweh’s house under the hand of the Levitical priests, whom David had distributed in Yahweh’s house, to offer the burnt offerings of Yahweh, as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as David had ordered.

Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.

Moreover Uzziah had an army of fighting men, who went out to war by bands, according to the number of their reckoning made by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.
You have granted me life and loving kindness.
Let his days be few.
What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?
Therefore they will carry away the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the brook of the willows.
For bronze I will bring gold;
Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination?

definitions.usage: account, (that have the) charge, custody, that which...laid up, numbers, office(-r), ordering, oversight, prison, reckoning, visitation.
definitions.full: H6486. pequddah מְּקֻדָּה 32 noun feminine oversight, mustering, visitation, store ; — absolute ׳פ Hosea 9:7 ; 1Chr 23:11 ; construct מְּקֻדַּת Num 3:32 +; suffix מְּקֻדָּתוֺ Num 109:8, etc.; plural מְּקֻדּ(וֺ)ת Jer 52:11 +; — 1 visitation: a. = punishment Hosea 9:7 ; Isa 10:3 ; Micah 7:4 ; Ezek 9:1 ; Num 16:29 (P), especially in מְּקֻדָּתָם עֵת(שְׁנַתׅ Jer 8:12 ; 10:15 6 t. Jeremiah (compare עֵת with מָּקַד 6:15 ; 49:8 ; 50:31 ), הַמּ ׳בֵּית = prison 52:11 . b. gracious visitation, providence Job 10:12 . 2. a. oversight, charge Num 4:16 (P), also 3:36 (P; redund.), 1Chr 26:30 ; = office 2Chr 23:18 . b. overseer (abstract for concrete), 2Kin 11:8 ; Ezek 44:11 (with אֶל of thing), Num 3:32 (P); collective = magistracy Isa 60:17 (Lag BN 151 ), compare 2Chr 24:11 . c. class of officers 1Chr 23:11 ; 24:3 , 19 . d. charge = thing entrusted Num 4:16 (P). 3 mustering 2Chr 17:14 ; 26:11 . 4 store , things laid up, Isa 15:7 ; Psa 109:8 (perhaps; Hup We Skizzen vi. 184 and others office ).
